name: Charged Greater Vital Spark
primary:
Lightning shoots from your hand into the creature you aim at (or the first one in your line of sight). In instant mode it strikes twice a second while held. Effects:
• Damage 3.5 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 105: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 8 targets in a row, jumps up to 6 blocks, 3.5 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Heals 1 ❤
• Regeneration: +0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 6 s
• Growth: up to 2 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
self_description:
